integrity: The covariance formula is derived directly from box indicators and two exact multinomial probabilities. The sign phase is reduced to a scalar power comparison, and the impossibility of zero covariance is proved by coprimality. Exact-rational enumeration is used only as supplementary replay.
scientific_limitations: The one-switch formula is for independent uniform allocation into a finite number of boxes.
The result is about covariance signs, not stronger positive/negative regression or stochastic association.
Classical finite-urn literature may contain an equivalent raw covariance identity; the originality claim is concentrated on the strict single-switch classification and the no-zero criterion.
title: A one-switch covariance law for occupancy richness and frequency counts
